title: Mirror Coating
prompt: What is sprayed on the back of a mirror?
hint: Two or three words; say the shiny layer that reflects light.

ja.prompt: 鏡の裏に何が吹き付けられていますか？
ja.hint: 2〜3語で。光を反射する光沢のある層を答えましょう。

local.prompt: What is sprayed on the back of a mirror?
local.hint: Two or three words; say the shiny layer that reflects light.

local_pron.prompt: wʌt ɪz spreɪd ɒn ðə bæk əv ə ˈmɪrər?
local_pron.hint: tuː ɔr θriː wɜrdz; seɪ ðə ˈʃaɪni leɪər ðæt rɪˈflɛkts laɪt.

zh.prompt: 鏡子的背面噴上了什麼？
zh.hint: 用兩到三個詞；說出能反射光的亮面層。

en.prompt: What is sprayed on the back of a mirror?
en.hint: Two or three words; say the shiny layer that reflects light.

en_pron.hint: tuː ɔr θriː wɜrdz; seɪ ðə ˈʃaɪni leɪər ðæt rɪˈflɛkts laɪt.

title: Security Alarm Sound
prompt: What happens when someone tries to open a protected door?
hint: Give a short sentence about the alarm sound that follows.

ja.prompt: 保護されたドアを誰かが開けようとすると何が起きますか？
ja.hint: 警報の音について短い文で答えましょう。
ja.sample: 警報がサイレンを鳴らします。

local.prompt: What happens when someone tries to open a protected door?
local.hint: Give a short sentence about the alarm sound that follows.

local_pron.prompt: wʌt ˈhæpənz wɛn ˈsʌmwʌn traɪz tuː ˈoʊpən ə prəˈtɛktɪd dɔr?
local_pron.hint: gɪv ə ʃɔrt ˈsɛntəns əˈbaʊt ði əˈlɑrm saʊnd ðæt ˈfɒloʊz.

zh.prompt: 當有人試圖打開受保護的門時會發生什麼？
zh.hint: 用短句說明隨之而來的警報聲。

en.prompt: What happens when someone tries to open a protected door?

title: Frames and Motion
prompt: What happens when frames are played quickly?
hint: Say that quick playback makes pictures look like movement.
sample: They create the illusion of movement.

ja.prompt: フレームを素早く再生すると何が起きますか？
ja.hint: 素早く再生すると絵が動いて見えることを伝えましょう。
ja.sample: それらは動いているように見えます。

local.prompt: What happens when frames are played quickly?
local.hint: Say that quick playback makes pictures look like movement.
local.sample: They create the illusion of movement.

local_pron.prompt: wʌt ˈhæpənz wɛn freɪmz ɑr pleɪd ˈkwɪkli?
local_pron.hint: seɪ ðæt kwɪk ˈpleɪbæk meɪks ˈpɪktʃərz lʊk laɪk ˈmuːvmənt.
local_pron.sample: ðeɪ kriˈeɪt ði ɪˈluːʒən əv ˈmuːvmənt.

zh.prompt: 當幀被快速播放會發生什麼？
zh.hint: 說明快速播放讓圖片看起來像是在移動。
zh.sample: 它們產生了移動的幻覺。

en.prompt: What happens when frames are played quickly?
en.hint: Say that quick playback makes pictures look like movement.
en.sample: They create the illusion of movement.
